Ch. 1
The minister in charge of cracking down on criminal gangs ended her term
Ch. 2
All sense of time had shattered. After several rounds of "play" — some brutal, some prolonged — Eiko was taken from the room that knew only footsteps and mockery.

This time, the process was eerily quiet. No one spoke. Only the sound of wheels rolling over a smooth floor and the faint, uncontrollable tremor of her own body filled the air. The smell changed, shifting from stale dust and sweat to something cold, metallic, tinged with the faint, sharp scent of disinfectant. Laboratory. The word stabbed into her consciousness like an ice pick.

She was transferred from the gurney onto a hard bed. The mattress was thin, allowing the cold, linear shape of the metal beneath to press clearly against her. Then, the restraints began.

Sight was the first to go. It wasn’t done brutally, but with a cold professionalism. A perfectly fitted, lightless blindfold was carefully adjusted, its edges sealing against her cheekbones and the bridge of her nose. The world’s contours and the faint ghosts of light were sucked away in an instant, leaving only an immense, weighty darkness.

Next came something that tasted of rubber and dust, a gag with breathing holes replaced the rough cloth, forcing her jaws apart, pressing any potential words back down her throat, leaving only the muffled, wet sound of her own breath. She instinctively tried to turn her head away, but a hand steadied the back of her skull — a practiced, indifferent motion.

The sound of leather against skin was stark in the dead silence. Her wrists were pulled firmly behind her back, overlapped, and a coarse strap tightened, biting into the wounds already worn there, bringing a familiar, dull pain. Then came the restraints that made her heart sink further.

A broad, cold strap cinched across her upper chest, pressing tightly just below her collarbones. Another ran parallel beneath her ribs, locking her ribcage in place. Every attempt at a deep breath met the unforgiving resistance of these two bands, making air a scarce and labored commodity.

Finally, her legs. Her knees were forced together, her ankles pressed tightly side-by-side. Straps tightened around her mid-calves and above her ankles, ensuring her lower limbs could scarcely part or bend to any significant degree. She was secured, like a carefully packaged object, straight and immobile, to the cold bed plate.

Her world now consisted only of hearing, touch, and an infinitely compressed, inward-pressing darkness. She could hear the low-frequency hum of some machine in the distance, feel the slight coolness of air moving over her skin, smell the unwelcoming "cleanliness" of the disinfectant. Most vivid of all was the drumming of her own heartbeat and the strenuous effort of each breath against the constriction. Despair was as thick as the darkness. But deep within the chaotic fear, that cold sliver of reason still churned stubbornly: They were beginning a new "experiment." And this time, she couldn't even resist with her eyes.
It's here.

Almost as soon as the thought formed, a sharp, feather-light sensation landed with perfect clarity on the arch of her right foot.

Eiko’s body jolted as if electrified, her back slamming against the cold bed plate. Her chest, constricted by the straps, heaved violently, trying to draw in more of the air her blocked mouth couldn't access. A short, choked sound—muffled and distorted by the gag into a strange grunt—escaped from deep in her throat. She wanted to curl, to flee, but her knees and ankles were locked together, leaving her legs to thrash like a pinned fish tail, straining and trembling within their minuscule range of motion.

The sensation didn't stop. It began to move.

Not a feather. The texture seemed smoother, cooler. Like… the soft bristles of a brush? Its tip traced a path with a precision that was itself cruel—from her heel, lingeringly up toward the ball of her foot, and back again. Not a rapid scratch, but a slow, sustained caress, as if savoring the scream of every over-sensitized nerve.

“Mmgh…! Mmmph—!” Laughter—or rather, the physiological spasms torture wrenched from her—finally breached the dam of suppression, erupting from behind the gag in her stuffed mouth. The sound was trapped in her throat and behind the tape, warped into fractured, staccato hitches and gulps for air. Tears welled uncontrollably, quickly soaking the fabric of the blindfold, adding a new, warm, and humiliating layer of sensation. She shook her head desperately, trying to dislodge the all-pervasive feeling.

The instrument changed location, moving to her left foot. Worse, it grew bored with simple lines and began to circle—small, tight, relentless circles—right over the most sensitive center of her arch.

“Hk…! Ngh—hk-hk…!”

Her laughter had changed pitch, laced now with the agony of suffocation and the despair of total loss of control. Her body's reactions were faster than her mind; every bound muscle fought the torment, succeeding only in driving the straps deeper, branding her skin with a burning ache that mingled with the maddening tickling into a hellish sensory storm. Sweat soaked through the thin garments, pasting them to her skin and the cold bed beneath. The darkness amplified it all—she couldn't see the expression of the one doing this, couldn't hear their breath, only her own deafening struggle can be heard. This unknown magnified the terror, making her feel less like she was being tortured by a person, and more like she was being consumed by an intangible, pure malice that fed on her distress.

At the edge of shattering, in the sensory chaos threatening to tear her apart, one last shred of consciousness flickered like a guttering flame. This wasn't for information. This was just… to break her. To grind the last remnants of her human dignity, her prized composure, into dust—slowly, meticulously—with this endless, childish, and horrifying tickle.
a new sensation arrived.

Not a strap, not a hand. An implement.

It first made contact with the sole of her right foot — a light, almost tentative touch. The texture wasn't the softness of a feather nor the roughness of leather. It had an artificial, cool, and uniformly elastic quality, like silicone or a carefully polished soft material. The sensation was distinct, but it held no warmth.

Eiko's body froze instantly, her breath catching. That indescribable, deep-seated fear, rooted in nerve reflexes, awoke faster than reason. The muscles in her toes tightened uselessly against their unseen bonds, the arch of her foot tensing slightly.

The implement began to move.

It didn't stroke or scratch. It rubbed. With a slow, steady, almost clinical rhythm, it started at her heel and moved upward, maintaining full contact with her skin, inch by deliberate inch. When it reached the sensitive hollow of her arch, it paused, applying a slightly more pronounced pressure, swirling slowly in that most vulnerable area.

"Mmph…!"

A severely stifled, guttural sound was wrenched from the depths of her blocked throat. It wasn't a cry of pain, but something more primal, more humiliating — a pure physiological reaction. The muscles of her entire calf began to twitch and tighten uncontrollably, desperate to curl away, to escape, but held fast and immobile by the firm straps at her knees and ankles. The utter helplessness of wanting to struggle but being utterly denied the means was nearly overwhelming.

The implement was like a dispassionate observer, cataloging every muscle tremor and every suppressed gasp. Devoid of any emotion, it carried out the act of "rubbing" with precision and persistence — left foot, then right, alternating — injecting that fine, sharp, maddening tickling sensation ceaselessly into her nerve endings.

Sweat, cold sweat, beaded on her temples, her neck, and trickled down her spine. It wasn't heat-induced; it was a secretion of despair, the body weeping in the face of extreme stimulus and absolute powerlessness. Then, the first laugh of the new round escaped past the gag. It sounded alien even to her — shattered, high-pitched, distorted by the padding and tape into a strange, muffled whimper. The sound was like a floodgate breaking.

Then came a second, a third… They chained together, completely beyond her control now. Her body writhed and bucked frantically against the restraints, as if trying to flee her own betraying nerves. Uncontrollable tears welled from beneath the blindfold, mixing with sweat and despair. She was laughing until her whole body trembled, laughing until she couldn't breathe, laughing like a broken doll.
The wandering sensations intensified abruptly. It was no longer a solitary probe, but like several invisible hands coming to life at once.

Their textures seemed slightly varied: some fingertips felt rougher, with a sandpaper-like grit; others were smooth and cool, like fine leather. They started on the soft, ticklish flesh of her tense flanks and waist, but their motions changed — no longer stroking, but kneading, scratching, even pressing with knuckles at a calculated pressure. The dense, multi-point assault instantly shattered any semblance of "rhythm" she might have previously discerned.

"Mmgh—!" A choked, near-screaming burst of laughter exploded from deep in her throat. Her hips arched violently off the bed as if electrocuted, only to be slammed back down by the straps across her torso with a dull thud. Her entire trunk began writhing uncontrollably side to side, a futile attempt to shake off the tenacious sensations. The laughter grew more fragmented, shrill, interspersed with suffocating gasps.

Then, amid this sensory tempest threatening to drown her, a new, more dreadful contact descended.

A lighter, yet more precise pressure settled along the upper curve of her breast. At first, it was an encircling caress, sparking a wave of scalp-prickling, ominous dread. Then, the sensation shifted — fingertips scratching, the edge of a nail grazing — targeting that vulnerable area, never before violated so methodically, yet dense with nerve endings.

"No…!"

The word screamed silently in her mind, manifesting as a distorted, tear-choked pant and muffled giggle through the gag. This was a different kind of tickling, laced with acute shame, deep-seated fear, and a physiological stimulation so intense it verged on madness. Tears flowed even more freely, quickly soaking the edges of the blindfold. She felt dismantled from the inside out, defiled, the last boundary of her "self" being cruelly clawed open.
"Strategy shift. From mapping reconnaissance to saturation attacks and humiliation targeting hyper-sensitive zones. The flanks are to induce violent struggle, exhausting physical stamina. The breasts… are to destroy dignity, testing the threshold of mental breakdown. recording the… limits."

Just when she thought the "map" of her body had been fully charted, a new assault descended without warning upon her feet.

First, the big toe of her right foot was clamped firmly by a cold, hard metal clip. The sensation was definitive and humiliating, a mark of ownership. Then, the rest of her toes fell one by one, the metal's chill piercing through her skin. Her toes instinctively tried to curl away from the sudden confinement and cold, but were mercilessly suppressed by the strap at her ankles, forced to remain in a stiff, splayed-open position.

Then, the true torment began.

Something insinuated itself inside.

It could have been the finest bristles of a brush, the pliant tip of a feather, or even just a steady stream of cool air. It slid, precise and slow, into the tight spaces between her clenched toes. The sensation was utterly different from anywhere else on her body. The skin here was thinner, the nerves more densely packed, and having been sheltered perpetually within socks and shoes, it had never experienced such direct, focused invasion.

"Mmgh—!!!"

A stifled, almost distorted whimper, trapped deep in her throat, shattered what little composure remained. All the accumulated tension, all the forcibly suppressed aftershocks of laughter, seemed to find a concentrated focal point all at once. What came from between her toes was a tickling so sharp it made her scalp crawl, so intricate there was no escape. It wasn't an impact, but like countless tiny electric currents, scurrying madly along the nerve endings in the webbing of her toes, shooting straight to her brain.

Her legs began a violent, futile tremor within the restraints at her knees and ankles, like two strings being plucked frantically by an invisible force. Her back arched uncontrollably off the cold slab before slamming back down. Gagged, her mouth emitted choked, wheezing gasps — the sound of laughter distorted by extreme sensory overload. Tears flowed so fiercely they nearly soaked the lower edge of the blindfold.
Just as the torturously intricate tickling between her toes churned her awareness into a chaotic white noise, another sound — like a red-hot ice pick — stabbed through all sensory barriers without warning, plunging straight into the core of her brain.

Laughter.

Wild, piercing, throat-shredding laughter.

It came from somewhere in the room — likely from the slightly tinny speaker of a device on the metal table to her left front. The laughter was interspersed with indistinguishable, broken words, uncontrollable, sob-tinged gasps, and pleas: "No… stop… haha… please… no…!"

All of Eiko's struggles froze in that instant.

Even the maddening sensation between her toes seemed to fade momentarily, or rather, was utterly eclipsed by a vaster, colder terror. Her body went rigid beneath the straps, with only uncontrollable, fine tremors remaining, like leaves in a cold wind.

She knew. She knew who it was.

Every inflection, every rhythm of the sobbing gasps, even the distinctive, near-asphyxiating tail-end of laughter pushed to its extreme… It was Shiori. Her nineteen-year-old daughter, Takatsukasa Shiori.

All the dams she had built with willpower — observation, calculation, active endurance — were as fragile as wet paper before this sound from her daughter. A hot, metallic tide of panic surged from her gut, slamming against her throat, only to be brutally forced back by the gag, becoming a silent explosion inside her.

"No. Impossible. How could they… How dare they…

It's fake. A recording. A simulation. To break me…

But that sob at the end… Shiori only does that when she's truly terrified…"
The crazed laughter from her daughter was like a poisoned thorn driven deep into her medulla, continuously releasing a toxin that paralyzed reason. Her brain screamed, but her thought processes felt mired in an expanding, viscous bog. The "analysis" and "resistance" she had barely maintained now seemed impossibly difficult; every clear thought that surfaced was immediately scattered and pulverized by that wild laughter and her own uncontrollable, physiological guffaws.

Amidst this abyss of severe psychological shock, another, more secretive and humiliating physiological change began to emerge from within her body.

At first, it was just a strange, almost unfamiliar feeling of bloating and pain that I hadn't experienced for a long time

It started as a strange, almost unfamiliar sense of fullness and pain that she hadn't experienced for a long time, a dull, aching heat with a sour, heavy quality, emanating from deep within her chest. She was confused for a moment before a bolt of icy horror shot through her — she remembered the unknown, cool liquid forcibly injected into her veins several times since her arrival. Not painkillers, not sedatives. The people in white coats had murmured terms like "prolactin," "simulated pregnancy hormones."

Now, under the catalysis of extreme mental trauma and relentless sensory stimulation, the drug's effects began to mature like a demonic fruit. Her mammary glands began a clumsy, painful "activation" against her will. The swelling sensation grew more pronounced, no longer a dull ache but a persistent, pressing fullness, like two hot stones weighing on her chest, throbbing with each uncontrolable breath and struggle. The straps cinched above and below her breasts transformed this swelling into a near-suffocating torture. Milk began to seep out uncontrollably, creating a cold, clammy sensation that intertwined with the fiery, all-consuming tickling crawling over her skin.

This betrayal and violation from within her own body, rich with symbolic meaning, nearly shattered her remaining sense of self. The most intimate, gentle biological function of motherhood had been forcibly awakened in this hellish context, becoming another instrument of torture inflicted upon her. She was no longer "Takatsukasa Eiko," not even a whole person, but more like a breaking maternal specimen under observation for all its biological responses.

Simultaneously, the omnipresent, tickle-induced hysterical laughter had gone on for too long. Hyperventilation starved her brain of oxygen; intense emotional and physical expenditure drained her energy. She felt her consciousness blunting. Like an overused dull blade, it could no longer slice through clear thought. External sounds and internal sensations all churned together into a boiling, nauseating stew. She tried to think of a plan, to recall her daughter's face, but her mind held only white noise and waves of irresistible, full-body tickling spasms.

Her laughter gradually changed tone. From high-pitched, sharp hysterics to broken, hoarse gasps, as if forced from the depths of her lungs, intermixed with swallowed sobs and drool. Her struggles diminished in scope, not from surrender, but from sheer exhaustion. Both body and mind had been pushed past their limits, teetering on the edge of snapping and plunging into endless darkness.

Yet, within that chaos and dullness threatening to consume everything, only two things remained unnaturally clear and sharp, like the last embers burning in the dark:

One was the full, persistent, milky pain in her chest.

The other was the endless sound from her daughter, that mix of wild laughter and desperate pleas.

One internal, one external; one defiling her "motherhood," the other tearing at her "mother's heart." They became the final two lighthouses of agony upon which her not-yet-shattered consciousness could anchor itself. In this inhuman hell, her identity as a "mother" was being engraved, in the cruelest way possible, onto the final pillar of her torment.
Just when she thought the betrayal and agony of her body had peaked, a new sound descended from above — a smooth, low mechanical hum mixed with the faint hiss of pneumatics.

She couldn't see it, but the sound descended mercilessly, carrying the inorganic chill of metal and rubber, coming to a precise halt directly above her chest. The next instant, two cool, soft, yet resilient rubbery shapes clamped firmly onto her already painfully swollen breasts. It was not a gentle contact, but a high-pressure, unequivocal seal, the edges gripping her skin tightly, instantly transforming the aching fullness into a deeper, vacuum-locked oppression. A milking machine.

Before the initial chill could even fade, something worse began.

Something emerged from deep within the suction cups. Not metal, not cool tubing. The sensation was… soft, moist, with a horrifyingly organic quality, like some form of resin or silicone tentacle covered in fine granules or ridged rings. They unerringly located her most sensitive nipples, now even more prominent due to lactation, and began their work.

It wasn't suction. It was licking.

With a slick, clammy wetness, in a rhythm that mimicked something biological — slow, coiling — they swirled, scraped, and pressed against her nipples and the most tender skin of her areolae. Each scrape injected a shudderingly sharp tickling sensation, mixed with the sore, aching pain of forced lactation, directly into her nervous system.

"Ghh… uuuuuh—!!!"

A completely distorted wail erupted from her gagged throat, no longer laughter but closer to the dry, visceral scream of a dying animal being disemboweled, forced from the depths of her lungs. Her body arched violently upwards as if struck by a high-voltage current, her neck straining back to a breaking point, every strap biting deep into her flesh at once. Her toes curled and splayed madly within the metal clips, the ankle restraints creaking under the strain.

This "tickling" was different from anywhere else. It targeted the most intimate organs, symbolizing "nurturing" and "life's bond," which had been forcibly activated. This wasn't just physical torment; it was the most ingenious crafted desecration and manipulation of the very core of her identity as a "mother." Each slithering movement of the wet tentacles seemed to mock the embraces and warmth she had once known, twisting the sacred function of motherhood into a sickening mechanical spectacle for observation and harvest.

The high-pressure suction cups on her chest began to rhythmically contract and release with a monotonous schlop, schlop sound, working in tandem with the wet, probing movements inside to mechanically extract the milk her body was being forced to produce. Simultaneously, the tentacles' licking became more intricate, more spiteful, as if seeking the precise balance between "tasting" and "stimulating" to provoke her most violent reactions.

Under this onslaught of sensations that exceeded human endurance — her daughter's crazed laughter shrieking in her ears, the inhuman mechanical tentacles violating and harvesting her chest, the fiery tickling crawling over every inch of her skin, and her brain screaming from oxygen lack and overload — her consciousness finally began to irreversibly dissolve.

The last flicker of attempt "comprehend" or "resist" was snuffed out like a candle in the wind. The world shattered into countless raw, savage fragments of sensation: sharp tickling, clammy wet, cold suction, burning fullness, desperate cries (indistinguishable now between Shiori's and her own)… These fragments spun madly, no longer able to coalesce into a complete "self."
She stopped struggling. Her body was left with only sporadic, unconscious twitches, like an empty shell brushed by the afterwaves of electricity. Transparent fluid, a mix of saliva and tears, streamed from her gagged mouth down her cheeks. Even the hoarse, breathless whimpers dwindled, finally subsiding into a hopeless, hollow silence. Only on her chest did the cold machine continue its rhythmic operation, emitting its monotonous sounds, performing the final, inhuman harvesting and desecration of the body that had once been "Takatsukasa Eiko."

In the depths of this chaotic consciousness, perhaps two primal, dark residues still floated:

One was pure terror of the never-ending licking and the tickling and shame it delivered to the core of her soul.

The other was the powerlessness, star-swallowing, destructive despair she felt towards the weakening, yet unceasing, sound of her daughter's laughter and pleas in her ear.

She lay collapsed on the cold metal bed, her body reduced to fine, neurasthenic t remors—the last meaningless conditioned reflexes of muscles under the joint assault of residual tickling and unceasing, hysterical laughter. The will to struggle remained, but the energy to drive it was exhausted. Her consciousness floated atop a murky swamp of fatigue and dull pain, like a drowning person on the verge of submersion.

It was in this state of total incapacitation that her body's betrayal reached its peak.

The persistent, maddeningly full pressure in her chest finally breached a critical threshold during one violent spasm of her torso triggered by the tickling. A rush of warm liquid, carrying her own body heat and that unfamiliar milky scent, abruptly spurted out. Not a slow seep, but an uncontrolled, forceful ejection; she could even feel the momentary cramping of the milk ducts as they emptied.

Before she could process further shame or collapse, Collection cups that sealed tightly around her swollen areolae, creating an airtight space. Every involuntary spurt or trickle was captured with ruthless efficiency by these unfeeling receptacles.

Then, a low motor hum began. The milking machine engaged. This was no natural or manual expression, but a mechanically precise, rhythmic suction via negative pressure. The pull came first as a sharp sting, then deepened into a hollow, aching soreness. With cold efficiency, the machine began to extract the milk abnormally produced in her body by the drugs and stimulation. The warm, white liquid gurgled through transparent tubing into a graduated glass container that slowly filled. The sounds—the faint rush of liquid, the regular drone of the motor—were maddeningly clear.

Her body, in this moment, was completely dismantled into functions.

Her nervous responses (tickling) were used as raw material to generate and observe pain.

Her throat and lungs (laughter) were used as an instrument to broadcast sounds of despair.

And her forcibly induced breasts (milk) had become a biological machine to be milked, producing a specific fluid.

The all-over tickling did not cease due to this new torture. Unseen tools or air currents continued their precise patrol of her underarms, waist, soles, persistently stimulated her already frayed nerve endings. The induced laughter therefore never stopped, only grew weaker, hoarser, more broken—like the dying gasps of a ruined bellows.

And from the speaker on the table, her daughter Shiori's crazed laughter, intermixed with pleas, still looped, echoed, forming a hellish duet with her own.

Visual darkness, auditory chaos, tactile torment (tickling and suction), and the alien sensation of being emptied from within… All these sensory inputs, churned by extreme exhaustion and helplessness, merged into a state beyond pain, approaching a kind of void. She no longer clearly distinguished the stimuli; they merged into a murky, constant river of agony washing over her.

Only the rhythmic pull of the machine and the image of milk flowing into the container (clearly constructed in her mind even unseen) remained as the most concrete realities within this void. They silently declared: Your humanity is being stripped away, consumed. What remains is living tissue that can still react, still be milked for "product."

In this moment, what Takatsukasa Eiko endured transcended personal revenge or torture. This was a cold, technical dismantling. The decomposition of a former National Public Safety Commission Chair into a series of observable, recordable, utilizable biological and psychological parameters. And her incapacitation was the necessary precondition for this process to proceed smoothly.
Ch. 3
Pushed through the door by their leather restraints, Tōdō Naoki and Morikawa Kumiko stumbled into the room. When they managed to raise their heads, what they saw stole their breath.

There, in the center of the room, was their supreme commander, the former National Public Safety Commission Chairperson—Takatsukasa Eiko—displayed in a state of utter degradation and agony. Her arms were wrenched and bound tightly behind her back, while her ankles were suspended by chains from the ceiling, forcing her body into a taut, vulnerable arc. She was made to maintain a precarious "seated" position using only the strength of her back and core. Sweat soaked her hair and thin clothing, glistening on her skin. Her eyes, hollowed by prolonged torment, drifted vaguely toward the source of the noise.

But the moment her gaze locked with that of the two women at the door—Tōdō and Morikawa, the core of the "Ikaruga" team she had forged and relied upon most—a violent transformation occurred in those empty depths.

It was as if an invisible spike shattered her pupils. Shock and disbelief flooded in, only to be instantly drowned by an abyssal, utter despair. She recognized them not as a leader seeing subordinates, but as a soul plunged into the deepest hell, seeing the last two ropes that might have saved her… only to realize those ropes were already severed and being dragged down into the darkness with her.

Her lips trembled, forming no sound, yet the despair was deafening. This was not merely despair for her own plight; it was the ultimate disillusionment with the entire system she had built and trusted. That even her sharpest "sword" and sturdiest "shield" had fallen meant every effort, every strategy, every sacrifice from her past was now being declared a complete, farcical failure by the enemy in the cruelest way possible.

The low, pleased chuckle of a guard echoed in the room. The purpose of this "meeting" was achieved: it was the ultimate taunt to Tōdō and Morikawa—"Behold, where is your invincible leader now?"—and it was the final, precise blow to Takatsukasa Eiko's spirit, extinguishing any last flickering fantasy of "possible rescue" or "her work surviving."

Despair, therefore, ceased to be an emotion. It became the very air she breathed.
But that moment of profound, catastrophic recognition was fleeting.

From the soles of her feet — the most sensitive, most cruelly "conditioned" part of her — that dreaded tickling sensation crept back in. A faint, feather-light touch. It was enough.

A hitch of breath, sharp and involuntary.

A sound, neither quite a whimper nor a laugh, escaped Takatsukasa Eiko's throat against her will. Her suspended body stiffened for an instant, making the chains creak, before a fine, uncontrollable tremor ran through her limbs. A flush of shame and agony flooded her face, erasing the deathly pallor of mere seconds before.

Thought was severed. Her consciousness was hijacked, dragged back into that sweetly-sharp sea of sensation. Two months of "training" had rewired her nervous system completely. The rationality that had stood at the pinnacle of national security, the despair laid bare before her subordinates — all of it crumbled like a sandcastle before a single stimulus crawling across her soles.

She could no longer be "Takatsukasa Eiko." What existed here now was merely a hyper-sensitive toy of flesh, returning predictable reactions — and she herself was the one most terrified and ashamed of that fact. Tears, without reason, spilled from her eyelids as a purely physiological response.
Before her former subordinates, a sound escaped her—a stifled, choked mixture of a sob and a laugh.

"...Hk... ah-ha..."

Tears streamed uncontrollably down her cheeks. Beads of sweat formed on her forehead and neck, succumbing to gravity and tracing slow paths down to the hollow of her collarbone. The overwhelming waves of tickling that assaulted her soles were now a physiological storm against which willpower was useless. She struggled frantically on the bed, shaking her suspended legs helplessly, rubbing her arched back against the surface. Ironically, even this desperate thrashing must have appeared to her tormentors as the ultimate "achievement."

The bed creaked. The ropes grated. Within that cacophony, layered the crumbling laughter of the once-imperturbable commander.
She had completely lost control of her body.

The itching in the soles of her feet was sharp and intricate, as if countless invisible feathers were simultaneously scratching the most sensitive nerve endings. The sensation crept upward along her ankles and calves, merging with a deeper, more maddening, weighty itch emanating from her buttocks.

She could no longer discern which was more unbearable. The final line of defense built by willpower collapsed utterly under this sensory deluge, attacking from within and without, from above and below. Her body had betrayed her, reduced to a mere vessel of reaction, waging a silent, violent, and futile war against its own perception within the confines of ropes and the bed.
The two elite agents from the International Criminal Special Investigations Office could now only watch from within their own restraints. The leather straps bit into their skin, a stark reminder of their powerlessness.

The spectacle before them was no longer mere brutality; it was a meticulously designed ritual—intended to dismantle, right before their eyes, the very symbol of order and authority they revered, reducing it piece by piece to primal physiological reactions and collapse.

Their breaths grew labored, stomachs clenching with a cold dread. This was not just a display; it was a clear announcement. They knew, with chilling certainty, that they would soon—likely imminently—be made to join that line, to transition from spectators to the next performers on this stage. Despair spread through them slowly, like the cold, metallic taste of rust.
